name: How can I prevent black soot from appearing on my ceilings in the future?

mainEntity.name: How can I prevent black soot from appearing on my ceilings in the future?

acceptedAnswer.text: Prevention involves addressing common sources of incomplete combustion. Regularly maintain fireplaces, chimneys, and gas appliances, ensuring they are venting properly. Use candles sparingly in well-ventilated areas and keep wicks trimmed. Avoid burning anything that produces excessive smoke. Ensure your HVAC system is serviced regularly, including changing filters, to prevent malfunctions that can distribute soot. Avoiding indoor smoking will also significantly reduce soot accumulation.
acceptedAnswer.description: Prevent soot by regularly maintaining fireplaces, chimneys, and gas appliances. Use candles carefully, ensure proper ventilation, service your HVAC, and avoid indoor smoking.
